reason: Fails rule 2 (fame), and the locator misleads. The wording checks out against a reader's page-by-page transcription of the Warburton text (Goodreads status, p. 132 of 176), including 'Moomintroll said to himself'. The line comes right after 'A family has to be ventilated at times'. But the proposal's fame test was 'closing', and the verifier has already dropped that claim. The same reader's later posts put a good deal of the book after p. 132: the bathing-house talk (p. 136), Too-ticky (p. 137), Little My on the ice (p. 141), the squirrel's return (p. 146) and Moominmamma (p. 148). So 'near the close' is inaccurate, both for the chapter and for the book. With the closing claim gone, no fame signal is left. The line is not the sentence the book is known by: that is Too-ticky's 'All things are so very uncertain', 205 likes. It is also absent from the roughly 45 most popular Moominland Midwinter quotations on Goodreads' work quotes page (pages 1 and 2 checked), and no standard reference entry was offered. Attribution, the speaker (Moomintroll), the cap, the ban and shipped status are all clean (shipped.js: 0 of 3, not banned, not shipped). The Internet Archive scans (Avon 1976, FSG 1992) are lending restricted and their search-inside returned 403, so the wording was not seen on a printed page.
